info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Aspen Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Aspen Drill Detail Management API facilitates the creation and management of detailed catalog entries for Aspen drills. This endpoint allows businesses to efficiently submit new drill specifications and attributes into the catalog. Designed for manufacturers and retailers, it supports streamlined integration of detailed product information into systems for inventory management and marketing purposes. Users can enhance their product offerings by providing comprehensive and accurate drill details, enabling better decision-making and improved customer service.

post.summary: Submit details for the Aspen drill.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit specific details related to the Aspen drill project. Ensure that all required fields in the request body are properly filled out before sending your request. Upon successful submission, a confirmation response will be returned.

requestBody.description: This request body should contain the necessary details for the Aspen Drill operation. Ensure that all required fields as specified in the schema are included to facilitate a successful operation.
